plan.title: Winning and Losing Vendor Award Visibility

steps.note: Open the already awarded event prepared for this case without recreating or changing its state.
Switch to the available vendor portal session for the winning vendor while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the awarded event in Vendor B's portal and remain on its overview.
Verify the winning vendor's portal identifies the event as awarded.
Verify the winning vendor's displayed amount corresponds to the awarded event's bid total.
